ModMetaData.name: LTS Ammunition - Inventory System Patch
ModMetaData.author: Allen / ChatGPT
ModMetaData.description: Independent RimWorld 1.5 patch for [LTS] Ammunition. Ammunition is stored and consumed directly from pawn inventory. LTS kits become ordinary carry-capacity backpacks, NPCs spawn with mass-based ammunition, and all pawns can pick visible compatible ammunition within 20 cells only when completely out of ammo.
